messages:
Mia: quick sync — after last night's postmortem the recurring cross-region TLS retry bursts look like a different beast than the DNS TTL flips we tracked earlier. p95 handshake timeouts spike before routing retries.
Ajay: I saw the same. seems correlated with connections landing on a cold GPU host in eu-west, long tcp handshake + tls renew = client retry cascade.
Sam: logs show ALB healthcheck flaps around the same time, small fraction but enough to shift traffic.
Taylor: is this definitely TLS handshake vs backend accept backlog? any packet captures?
Mia: we have a couple pcaps from 03/21 02:14 UTC. sharing link: https://redwood.internal/pm/2623456789/pcaps (internal)
Olivia: quick note — infra-bot alerted on 02:14 for "tls-handshake-timeout" and auto-evicted 3 hosts. that eviction likely amplified routing swings.
infra-bot: alert: tls-handshake-timeout threshold exceeded (p90 8s > 5s) — automated host ejection applied.
Ajay: propose 3 immediate actions: 1) rollback aggressive host-ejection rule, 2) increase TLS accept timeout to 10s on LB, 3) run controlled canary to validate. owners: Ajay(rollback), Sam(timeout), Taylor(canary). target: Mar 30.
Sam: working on LB config change. quick patch below to increase accept timeout on envoy:
```yaml
listener_filters:
  - name: envoy.filters.listener.tls_inspector
  - name: envoy.filters.network.tcp_proxy
  - idle_timeout: 10s
```
Mia: add a follow-up to postmortem with explicit ownership and test plan. also add runbook step to avoid automated ejection during cross-region spikes.
Taylor: can run canary at low traffic windows Thu 02:00 UTC. will monitor p50/p95 handshake and routing churn.
Olivia: I'll update the incident tracker with owners + docs link.
Mia: long(er)-term: research why cold hosts have handshake CPU spikes — maybe kernel crypto path or quantization jitter. assign to Sam & Ajay for deeper root cause. timeline: sprint 2 (by Apr 14).
Ajay: logging action items here: 
- [ ] rollback-eject-rule (owner: Ajay) due: 2026-03-30
- [ ] lb-tls-timeout-change (owner: Sam) due: 2026-03-30
- [ ] canary-and-observe (owner: Taylor) due: 2026-03-31
- [ ] postmortem-update + runbook (owner: Olivia) due: 2026-03-29
- [ ] deep-root-cause (owners: Ajay, Sam) due: 2026-04-14
Mia: tagging @oncall-team for visibility. please ack who will block if any of these slip.
Taylor: ack, I'll raise if canary shows regression.
Olivia: acked and I'll coordinate comms with CS if this impacts customers. :wave:
Sam: starting LB change now, will post PR link when ready.
Ajay: thanks — let's micro-update this thread after each action so we have a concise trail for the postmortem. :thumbsup:
